decisions.name: Functional Requirements
decisions.rationale: [{'title': 'Submit CV', 'description': 'Applicants can submit their CVs for parsing and analysis.', 'source': {'page': '4.1', 'start_index': '15'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'View and Edit CV', 'description': 'Applicants can view and edit their parsed CV.', 'source': {'page': '4.1', 'start_index': '15'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Answer Screening Questions', 'description': 'Applicants are presented with screening questions defined by an expert recruiter.', 'source': {'page': '3.5', 'start_index': '13'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Get Rating for CV', 'description': 'The system generates a percentage-based result, providing a fair evaluation of each applicant.', 'source': {'page': '3.5', 'start_index': '13'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}]

decisions.name: Non-Functional Requirements
decisions.rationale: [{'title': 'Performance', 'description': 'The system MUST respond to user input within 2 seconds.', 'source': {'page': '6.1', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Reliability', 'description': 'The system SHALL be available 99.9% of the time.', 'source': {'page': '6.2', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Security', 'description': 'The system MUST protect user data and MUST NOT store sensitive information.', 'source': {'page': '6.3', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Privacy', 'description': 'The system MUST NOT collect or store user data without consent.', 'source': {'page': '6.4', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Scalability', 'description': 'The system SHOULD be able to handle 1000 concurrent users.', 'source': {'page': '6.5', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Usability', 'description': 'The system MUST be user-friendly and MUST provide clear instructions.', 'source': {'page': '6.6', 'start_index': '21'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Maintainability', 'description': 'The system SHOULD be easy to modify and update.', 'source': {'page': '6.7', 'start_index': '22'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Compatibility', 'description': 'The system MUST be compatible with major browsers and MUST NOT have any known bugs.', 'source': {'page': '6.8', 'start_index': '22'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}, {'title': 'Integration', 'description': 'The system MUST integrate with HR module from Odoo ERP software.', 'source': {'page': '3.2', 'start_index': '11'}, 'project_id': 'proj_deb82ab2'}]

components.name: CV Editor
components.responsibility: Allow applicants to view and edit their parsed CVs

components.name: Screening Question Manager
components.responsibility: Manage and present screening questions to applicants

components.name: Rating Generator
components.responsibility: Generate a percentage-based result for each applicant's CV

runtime_flow.action: Parse CV and send data to CV Editor
Request screening questions from Screening Question Manager
Send applicant's answers to Rating Generator
Send parsed CV data to Rating Generator
Send rating result to CV Editor

critique.issue: The CV Parser component may experience performance issues if it is unable to parse complex CVs within the 2-second response time requirement (NFR: Performance).
The CV Editor component may not meet the usability requirement (NFR: Usability) if it does not provide clear instructions for editing parsed CVs.
The Screening Question Manager component may not meet the maintainability requirement (NFR: Maintainability) if it is not easy to modify and update the screening questions.
The Rating Generator component may not meet the scalability requirement (NFR: Scalability) if it is unable to handle a large number of concurrent users and generate ratings efficiently.
The Rating Generator component may not meet the reliability requirement (NFR: Reliability) if it is unable to generate accurate ratings consistently.
The CV Parser component may not meet the security requirement (NFR: Security) if it stores sensitive information about applicants.
The Screening Question Manager component may not meet the integration requirement (NFR: Integration) if it does not integrate correctly with the HR module from Odoo ERP software.
The CV Editor component may not meet the compatibility requirement (NFR: Compatibility) if it does not work correctly with major browsers.
